manual_steps: 1. Static type checking & lint verification (npm run build / tsc --noEmit)
2. Unit and integration test execution (npm test)
5. Git working tree audit (git status to verify no uncommitted changes)
micro_exercise.scaling_failure_modes: Manual execution fails at scale due to human fatigue, skipped tests during crunch time, environment divergence across developer workstations, and dirty local builds containing untracked files. Automated CI/CD provides a deterministic clean-room execution environment on every commit.
